name: Autocontent
author: Remwes, LLC

sections.description: Quality content is essential for enhancing your website’s search engine rankings. Autocontent creates blog posts tailored to your website’s preferences by transmitting your preferences to the Autocontent service to generate blog content.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Click ‘Add New’.
  4. Type ‘Autocontent’, click ‘Install Now’ and activate it.
  5. You will be automatically redirected to the Autocontent Setup Wizard.
  6. Fill out the subject and keywords fields, then select the appropriate tone for your desired blog posts.
  7. Click ‘Save Changes’ once you are done.
  8. Next, click ‘Generate Post Now’.
  9. That’s it! Click the link to read your new post.

Manual Installation

  1. Visit the Autocontent plugin page here
  2. Click the blue ‘Download’ button on the top-right of the page.
  3. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  4. Navigate to the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  5. Click on the ‘Upload Plugin’ button at the top of the page.
  6. Click ‘Choose File’ and browse to the zip file you downloaded in step 2.
  7. Click ‘Activate’ under the Autocontent plugin in the list.
  8. You will be automatically redirected to the Autocontent Setup Wizard.
  9. Fill out the subject and keywords fields, then select the appropriate tone for your desired blog posts.
  10. Click ‘Save Changes’ once you are done.
  11. Next, click ‘Generate Post Now’
  12. That’s it! Click the link to read your new post.

Upgrade Instructions

  1. After installing Autocontent, by default you will be on the Freebie Plan.
  2. To upgrade from the default free plan, visit autocontent.com and click Registration to create an account.
  3. Complete the registration process using a valid email address.
  4. Log in to your account to access your Dashboard.
  5. On the Dashboard, navigate to the Plans section.
  6. Review and select your desired plan Pro or Ultimate.
  7. Click on Purchase and proceed to the Checkout page.
  8. Enter your payment information and complete the purchase.
  9. After completing the purchase, an Activation key for the purchased plan will be generated.
  10. The Activation key will be available in your Dashboard and sent to your email.
  11. Use the Activation key in the Autocontent plugin’s Settings page (in your website’s WordPress Dashboard) to activate the upgraded plan and start generating content.
sections.faq:
How Do I Activate Autocontent?

Simply download, install and activate the plugin. You will be automatically assigned an activation key for the free plan.

How Do I Upgrade?

To upgrade to a premium plan with weekly or daily blog content posts, please visit our Pricing page and signup for the plan that best suits your needs.
